## Engineering Blog & Technical Articles
- **Blog Index (English - Outside Indonesia Default)**: https://roisfaozi.com/blog
- **Blog Index (Bahasa Indonesia - Indonesia Geo-Routed)**: https://roisfaozi.com/id/blog
- **RSS Feed**: https://roisfaozi.com/rss.xml
- **Featured Study - Cutting PostgreSQL Query Latency by 90% in High-Volume Go Systems**:
  - English URL: https://roisfaozi.com/blog/cutting-postgresql-query-latency-90-percent
  - Indonesian URL: https://roisfaozi.com/id/blog/cutting-postgresql-query-latency-90-percent
  - Summary: Architectural breakdown using a synthetic reference model to demonstrate how P95 query latency on 40,000+ records was reduced from 9s down to 900ms (90% reduction) in Go and PostgreSQL. Covers query timing histograms, replacing correlated `EXISTS` subqueries with pre-resolved scope predicates, composite B-tree indexes on `(scope_column, registered_at DESC)`, eliminating non-SARGable `LOWER(COALESCE(...))` function wrappers, omitting unused satellite `LEFT JOIN`s in `COUNT(*)`, separating lean list projections from heavy `JSONB` detail projections, opt-in secondary cache hydration, and a 3-second in-memory `expirable.LRU` cache verified with `go-sqlmock` and `k6`.
